text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san. It has come around again this 
year, your birthday—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, the day of the decisive battle is!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ouuusssss!!!! Yaeno... Thank you so much 
for putting up with my training up until 
today, 'ssu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"No, if it's a match with family... 
especially with your master, I'd drop 
everything to join you."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I understand all too painfully well that 
feeling of wanting to surpass your 
master...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, let me ask frankly: 
What do you honestly think your chances of 
winning are...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Years of crossing swords every birthday— 
yet there's still so much where I can't 
measure up to my father.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
B-But I can win this year!! I know I can!! 
All those days of training with Yaeno gave 
me courage and confidence!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am certain you shall claim a 
glorious victory!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I, Yaeno, shall pray for your certain 
victory from right here at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'm all fired up now! This 
year, I'm definitely gonna win--!!
